goal: Dark theme only, offline walk and DESIGN.md check (T7; Board gate 190: T7 removes the prefers-color-scheme listener): finish theme tokens and verify AC-83, AC-84, AC-86, AC-87.

acceptance_criteria.text: databoot.css has no 'prefers-color-scheme', no '@font-face', and holds #050a12, #4de1ff, #ffb454, a monospace system font stack and color-scheme: dark; dashboard.js has no matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') variable or listener (only the phone query is kept) and charts read the dark tokens through tokens() whatever the emulated OS scheme

Playwright (tests/test_theme_round7.py): with emulated color scheme light and dark, body background computes to rgb(5, 10, 18) and the cyan/amber tokens resolve; body and label text keep contrast >= 4.5:1 against the effective tile background; charts keep one y-axis and bars sorted from zero (existing checks still green); token-reading tests (AC-50 --div-mid, AC-69, test_table_toggle) are re-run and pass

Offline walk (AC-86): one Playwright test records every request while it opens /, uploads files, waits for /scan, opens the workspace, drags and expands/closes a tile, toggles a table view and filters inside the overlay; all requests go to the app's own host

AC-87: a text test reads docs/DESIGN.md: a heading containing 'round 7' whose section lists #050a12, #4de1ff, #ffb454, 'mono', 'header', 'drag handle', 'expand', 'table toggle', '12-column', '0.6 s', 'reduced motion' and 'reduced transparency'; the section is edited only if a term is missing, and says the portal rings always turn (Board gate 190)
The full pytest suite is run once at the end, alone, and its result reported; failures are fixed in the app, not in tests/test_acceptance.py
Moves acceptance items AC-83, AC-84, AC-86, AC-87 forward

decisions.what: Made no code change in attempt 2; attempt 1's commit already holds the CSS/JS cleanup, tests/test_theme_round7.py, tests/test_round7_offline.py and the DESIGN.md check
decisions.why: Targeted tests pass and the stylesheet, JS and DESIGN.md already match every acceptance line
decisions.evidence: pytest tests/test_theme_round7.py tests/test_round7_offline.py tests/test_table_toggle.py (11 passed); -k 'AC_50 or AC_69' (2 passed); git show --stat HEAD

tried_and_failed.what: First full-suite run in the background with the default 600 s limit
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The harness stopped it at 600 s; the suite takes about 800 s, so it needs a background timeout of 2,400,000 ms

assumptions: test_AC_42 failing in the full run (5.0 s cold-time limit on /datasets/{id}) was load from overlapping runs, because it passes alone at 3.59 s and no app code changed
open_questions: test_AC_42's cold-start budget is tight (3.6 s alone against a 5.0 s limit) and failed once in a full run; the QA role may want to look at its margin, since tests/test_acceptance.py is protected

lessons.lesson: Start the full pytest suite once with run_in_background and timeout 2400000; it takes about 13 minutes, and a default-timeout run is killed. Do not start a second run while the first may still be alive, because the overlap slows the timing tests (AC_42).
lessons.when: Any ticket that must run the full suite
lessons.evidence: first run killed at 600 s; second full run 804 s with test_AC_42 failing at its 5 s cold limit, passing alone at 3.59 s
